svg.title: Подъём на носки с гантелями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing bilateral dumbbell calf raise with one identifiable dumbbell in each hand, arms relaxed at sides, side-front three-quarter view emphasizing ankle contact. START two feet flat on the same floor. FINISH both heels visibly lifted 5–8 cm while toes and balls of BOTH feet still contact same floor line, ankles plantarflexed. Keep knees nearly straight and trunk upright, no platform, no jumping. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
